title: Medical Virtual Assistant
why_it_fits: Virtual Assistant match. 2 skills: excel, admin. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
NeoWork is hiring Medical Virtual Assistants to support U.S. healthcare practices with front-office and administrative work. You will help patients get scheduled, verified, and supported, so providers can focus on care.

NeoWork is a global staffing and operations partner that builds dedicated remote teams for fast-growing U.S. companies. Our teammates work directly inside our clients' teams and tools, while NeoWork takes care of recruiting, HR, benefits, and ongoing support.
key_responsibilities:
Answer and place patient calls for scheduling, reminders, and general inquiries
Verify insurance eligibility and benefits and support pre-authorization requests
Process patient intake forms and update records in the EHR
Coordinate referrals, follow-ups, and communication with providers
Route clinical or billing questions to the right staff
Handle all patient information in a HIPAA-compliant manner

1+ year of experience in a medical office, healthcare call center, or patient services role
Excellent spoken and written English with a calm, professional phone manner
Familiarity with medical terminology
Experience using EHR or practice management systems
Strong organization and multitasking skills
Availability to work U.S. business hours
Based in the Philippines, with a reliable home office setup and stable internet connection

Nice to Have
Experience with insurance verification or prior authorizations
Experience with systems such as AdvancedMD, athenahealth, or eClinicalWorks

Health Maintenance Organization (HMO)
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Mental Health Leave
Birthday Leave
Gym Allowance
Extra Holiday Pay
Remote Work Setup
Opportunities for professional growth and development
